rejected_reasons: Fixture-only cleanup would leave production marketplace financial classification coupled to a jurisdiction-specific alias.
Scanner carve-outs would hide canonical-base coupling instead of removing it.

findings: No entitlement, listing, seller trust, metering idempotency, or billing-account validation was relaxed; invalid marketplace currency, discount, region, and lifecycle tests still pass.
Preserves marketplace domain boundaries and local dependencies; no adapter or API coupling was introduced.

Existing behavior assertions remain covered: seller onboarding, verification, listing draft/publication, public metadata classification, revenue share, private-offer terms/currency/time order, entitlement support-region and accepted-offer binding, and marketplace fee idempotency.
